title: Terraform or Ansible: Provisioning vs Configuration Management
excerpt: These two tools are often compared but solve different problems. Terraform creates and changes infrastructure; Ansible configures systems once they exist. Understanding the split helps you use each where it fits.
verdict: Think of them as partners rather than rivals. Use Terraform to declare and provision cloud and on-premises infrastructure, with a state file tracking every resource. Use Ansible to configure operating systems and applications on that infrastructure. Many teams run both in the same pipeline.
